section.p:
Consider a "Supported File Extensions" chapter in a "File Processing Reference Guide" document where you want to display a short lookup-style table without a title or caption. Supported File Extensions The application supports multiple import and export file formats.

The following file extensions are supported by the import engine:

Extension Description .csv Comma-separated values file .xml Structured XML document .json JavaScript Object Notation file
Result: Use <simpletable> for compact reference-style data when the table does not require a caption, complex spanning, nested tables, and column specifications.
